reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity; this wrapper deals 4x/year. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure — CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).

Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of NAV (board-discretionary quarterly tenders, Rule 13e-4 - NOT an interval fund) — a FUND-level cap; at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.
Scenario demand (illustrative): 7.2% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity — adequate headroom at this allocation if offers are not prorated.
Cadence reliability evidence: four offers conducted in EACH of FY2025/FY2026 (3.3).
Early repurchase economics: 2.00% of NAV if held < 1 year, FIFO (2.7) — relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
